comment: Arena checkpoints (every 'every' waves): Arena AP to spend; unspent AP carries over.

tickets.comment: AC Deli Tickets per wave cleared (arena only; reset when the run ends).

training.comment: AC training room: 1 AP a session, once per member per camp, at most capPerRun stat points per member per run; a minigame score of 'good' or better gives +1.
